description: This is a unit test class for the MutablePermissions class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It contains test methods to verify the behavior of permission management including adding, removing, equality, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: MutablePermissionsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for MutablePermissions, testing addition, removal, equality, JSON serialization, and other behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the 'underTest' object before each test by creating a new empty Permissions instance.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract for MutablePermissions class using EqualsVerifier, with special handling for collection extension.

methods.name: tryToAddNull
methods.description: Checks that adding null to permissions throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: addNonExistingEntry
methods.description: Tests that adding a new permission (READ) successfully adds it to the permissions set.

methods.name: addExistingEntryAgain
methods.description: Tests that adding a permission already present (WRITE) returns false and the set remains unchanged.

methods.name: createNewMutablePermissionsFromGivenSet
methods.description: Creates a MutablePermissions object from a set of all permissions and verifies its contents.

methods.name: removeExistingEntry
methods.description: Tests removing an existing permission from the set and verifies the set updates correctly.

methods.name: removeNonExistingEntry
methods.description: Attempts to remove a permission not present, expects false, and that the set remains empty.

methods.name: containsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the 'contains' method correctly verifies presence of permissions individually and in groups.

methods.name: createJsonRepresentationOfEmptyMutablePermissions
methods.description: Verifies the JSON serialization output when permissions set is empty.

methods.name: createJsonRepresentationOfMutablePermissions
methods.description: Verifies the JSON serialization output when all permissions are added.
